# PromotionSure

PromotionSure is an independent online practice platform for Nigerian public servants preparing for public service promotion examinations.

## Public Pages

- Home: https://promotionsure.com.ng/
- Support: https://promotionsure.com.ng/support
- Privacy Policy: https://promotionsure.com.ng/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://promotionsure.com.ng/terms
- Sitemap: https://promotionsure.com.ng/sitemap.xml

## What PromotionSure Provides

- Objective practice questions for public service promotion exam preparation.
- Oral response practice for modules that support oral preparation.
- Timed practice sets, scores, answer review, and progress tools for signed-in candidates.
- Paid module access and receipts through a specialist payment provider.
- Signed-in support for account, access, payment, content, and technical issues.

## Audience

PromotionSure is intended for adults preparing for Nigerian public service promotion examinations.

## Access Notes

Public marketing, support, privacy, and terms pages may be crawled. Candidate dashboards, practice sessions, review pages, payment pages, profile pages, and admin pages require authentication and should not be indexed.

## Contact

Support email: promotionsureapp@gmail.com
